card.name: Space before a following noun phrase
card.fires_on: Mostly a bare space token (or a comma) in general web prose, often just before a noun like section, the, or possibly. It is common in science and nature texts, but the next word varies.

modes.label: Space before 'section'
modes.description: A space after Longitudinal or Histological, just before the word section in plant-pathology figure captions.

modes.description: A space after a subject or preposition in general news or history prose, just before the next word.
